analysis.summaryJa: 比較級の後ろのthanが比較の基準を区切る境界線であることを中心に、rather thanによる選択、superior・seniorがthanではなくtoを取る例外、not・no・anyと比較級の組合せ、than後の目的格代名詞を整理する。
grammarPoints: 比較級＋thanで基準との差を示す
rather thanで一方を退けてもう一方を選ぶ
not・no・any＋比較級で限定・否定・改善の有無を表す
than後の代名詞は会話では目的格が自然
visualEvidence: AとBの塔をTHANゲートが分け、比較級から基準へ矢印が伸びる図
rather thanがAを離れてBを選ぶ分岐として描かれている
not/no/any＋比較級の青い修飾帯と、目的格meを示すミニ確認
commonTraps: 比較級の基準にthan以外を置く
rather thanの前後で並列する形をそろえない
no betterとnot betterの意味の強さを混同する
thanの後ろに主格だけが正しいと思い込む

questions.prompt: The express service is considerably faster ------- standard delivery.

choices.B: from

questions.translationJa: 速達サービスは通常配送よりかなり速いです。
questions.explanationJa: 比較級fasterの基準standard deliveryはthanで導きます。

questions.prompt: The director decided to postpone the launch ------- release an unfinished product.

choices.B: than

questions.translationJa: 部長は未完成の製品を発売するのではなく、発売を延期することにしました。
questions.explanationJa: 二つの選択肢を対比して一方を選ぶrather thanが適切です。

questions.prompt: This security system is superior ------- the one installed last year.

choices.B: from

questions.translationJa: このセキュリティシステムは昨年設置されたものより優れています。
questions.explanationJa: superiorは比較の基準をtoで導き、thanは取りません。

questions.prompt: Has the connection become ------- more stable since the router was replaced?

choices.B: any

questions.translationJa: ルーターを交換してから、接続は少しでも安定しましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 疑問文で改善が少しでもあるかを尋ねるany more stableが自然です。

questions.prompt: Our proposal was more detailed ------- the client had expected.

choices.B: to

questions.translationJa: 当社の提案は顧客が予想していたより詳しいものでした。
questions.explanationJa: more detailedの基準となる節はthanで導きます。

questions.prompt: Ms. Arai is senior ------- me, although she joined this division later.

choices.B: from

questions.translationJa: 新井さんはこの部署への配属は私より後ですが、私より年上です。
questions.explanationJa: seniorはto＋目的格で比較対象を示します。

questions.prompt: The temporary fix is no more reliable ------- the damaged part it replaced.

choices.B: than

questions.translationJa: 応急処置は、交換対象となった破損部品と同様に信頼できません。
questions.explanationJa: no more A than Bは、Bと同様にAではないという強い否定です。

questions.prompt: The team chose to rent equipment ------- purchase machines needed for only one event.

choices.B: than

questions.translationJa: チームは1回の催事だけに必要な機械を購入せず、機器を借りることにしました。
questions.explanationJa: rentとpurchaseという動詞原形をrather thanで並列しています。

questions.prompt: The revised estimate is not higher ------- the amount approved by the board.

choices.B: as

questions.translationJa: 改訂見積額は取締役会が承認した金額より高くありません。
questions.explanationJa: not higher thanで「基準を超えない」を表します。

questions.prompt: The afternoon session lasted longer ------- anyone on the planning team anticipated.

choices.B: as

questions.translationJa: 午後の部は企画チームの誰もが予想したより長く続きました。
questions.explanationJa: 比較級longerと完全な節をつなぐthanが必要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence comparing two meeting rooms.

choices.A: Room B is brighter to Room A.
choices.B: Room B is brighter than Room A.
choices.C: Room B is more bright as Room A.
choices.D: Room B is brightest than Room A.

questions.translationJa: 会議室Bは会議室Aより明るいです。
questions.explanationJa: 比較級brighterの基準はthanで示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a purchasing decision.

choices.A: We repaired the copier rather replacing it.
choices.B: We repaired the copier rather to replace it.
choices.C: We repaired the copier than rather replacing it.
choices.D: We repaired the copier rather than replacing it.

questions.translationJa: 私たちはコピー機を交換するのではなく修理しました。
questions.explanationJa: repairedとreplacingをrather thanで対比する自然な構文です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence evaluating a product.

choices.A: The premium filter is superior to the standard model.
choices.B: The premium filter is superior than the standard model.
choices.C: The premium filter is more superior to the standard model.
choices.D: The premium filter is superior as the standard model.

questions.translationJa: 高級フィルターは標準モデルより優れています。
questions.explanationJa: superior自体に比較の意味があり、toを取ります。moreは重ねません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about two colleagues.

choices.A: Mr. Bell is senior than me by three years.
choices.B: Mr. Bell is more senior to I by three years.
choices.C: Mr. Bell is senior to me by three years.
choices.D: Mr. Bell is senior from me by three years.

questions.translationJa: ベルさんは私より3歳年上です。
questions.explanationJa: senior to＋目的格meが正しい形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question about a repaired air conditioner.

choices.A: Is the office no cooler now?
choices.B: Is the office any coolest now?
choices.C: Is the office more cool any now?
choices.D: Is the office any cooler now?

questions.translationJa: オフィスは今、少しでも涼しくなりましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 疑問文で変化の有無を尋ねるany coolerが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence setting an upper limit.

choices.A: The parcel is not heaviest than twenty kilograms.
choices.B: The parcel is not heavier than twenty kilograms.
choices.C: The parcel is no heavy to twenty kilograms.
choices.D: The parcel is not heavier to twenty kilograms.

questions.translationJa: その小包は20キロより重くありません。
questions.explanationJa: not heavier thanは20キロを超えないという中立的な上限です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence making a strong negative comparison.

choices.A: This backup is not more complete to the corrupted file.
choices.B: This backup is no complete as the corrupted file.
choices.C: This backup is no more complete than the corrupted file.
choices.D: This backup is no most complete than the corrupted file.

questions.translationJa: このバックアップは破損ファイルと同様に完全ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: no more A than Bは両方ともAではないという強い否定を作ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence comparing personal performance.

choices.A: Lina processes orders faster than me.
choices.B: Lina processes orders faster to me.
choices.C: Lina processes orders more fast than I.
choices.D: Lina processes orders fastest than me.

questions.translationJa: リナは私より速く注文を処理します。
questions.explanationJa: 会話的な比較ではthanの後ろに目的格meを置けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence comparing an outcome with an expectation.

choices.A: Attendance was lower that we had predicted.
choices.B: Attendance was more low than we had predicted.
choices.C: Attendance was lower to our prediction was.
choices.D: Attendance was lower than we had predicted.

questions.translationJa: 出席者数は私たちの予測より少なかったです。
questions.explanationJa: thanの後ろにwe had predictedという基準節を置けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence preferring an online meeting.

choices.A: Let us meet online rather than everyone travels.
choices.B: Let us meet online than rather make everyone travel.
choices.C: Let us meet online rather than make everyone travel.
choices.D: Let us meet online rather to make everyone travel.

questions.translationJa: 全員を出張させるのではなく、オンラインで会議をしましょう。
questions.explanationJa: meetとmakeという動詞原形がrather thanで釣り合っています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The new schedule is busier than the old one."

choices.A: Both schedules contain the same number of activities.
choices.B: The old schedule replaced the busier one.
choices.C: The new schedule has already ended.
choices.D: The old schedule was less busy than the new one.

questions.translationJa: 旧日程は新日程ほど忙しくありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: thanの両側を入れ替え、busierをless busyにすると比較関係が保たれます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We sent an email rather than calling."

choices.A: We called after sending an email.
choices.B: We chose email instead of a phone call.
choices.C: We used both email and a phone call.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは電話ではなくメールを選びました。
questions.explanationJa: rather thanは一方を選びもう一方を選ばないことを表し、instead ofと対応します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "This material is superior to plastic."

choices.A: This material is made from plastic.
choices.B: Plastic is newer than this material.
choices.C: This material is better than plastic.

questions.translationJa: この素材はプラスチックより優れています。
questions.explanationJa: be superior toはbe better thanと同じ比較を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The fee is not higher than $80."

choices.B: The fee must be more than $80.
choices.C: The fee is exactly $80 in every case.

questions.translationJa: 料金は80ドル以下です。
questions.explanationJa: not higher thanは基準額を超えないという上限を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The repair left the machine no safer."

choices.A: The repair made the machine completely safe.
choices.B: The machine is just as unsafe as it was before the repair.
choices.C: The machine is safer than every other model.
choices.D: No one checked the machine after the repair.

questions.translationJa: 修理後もその機械は以前と同じくらい危険なままです。
questions.explanationJa: no saferは安全性が少しも増していないことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Is the revised report any clearer?"

choices.A: Is this the clearest report in the archive?
choices.B: Why was the report revised twice?
choices.C: Is any report clearer than this one?
choices.D: Has the revision made the report even slightly easier to understand?

questions.translationJa: 改訂によって報告書は少しでも理解しやすくなりましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 疑問文のany clearerは、わずかでも改善があるかを尋ねます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Ms. Cole is senior to me."

choices.A: Ms. Cole is older than I am.
choices.B: Ms. Cole joined the company after I did.
choices.D: Ms. Cole and I are the same age.

questions.translationJa: コールさんは私より年上です。
questions.explanationJa: 年齢についてsenior toはolder thanと言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The task took longer than expected."

choices.A: The task ended earlier than planned.
choices.B: No completion time had been estimated.
choices.C: The task was not completed as quickly as anticipated.

questions.translationJa: その作業は予想したほど速く完了しませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: longer than expectedはnot as quickly as anticipatedと同じ時間差です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "This solution is no better than the first."

choices.B: The first solution is slightly worse.
choices.C: This is the best of several solutions.
choices.D: Only the first solution was tested.

questions.translationJa: どちらの解決策にも改善はありません。
questions.explanationJa: no better thanは、比較対象と同様に良くないという強い否定です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "I would walk rather than wait another hour."

choices.A: I plan to walk after waiting for an hour.
choices.B: I would prefer walking to waiting for another hour.
choices.C: I cannot walk for more than an hour.
choices.D: I would rather wait than walk.

questions.translationJa: さらに1時間待つより歩く方を選びます。
questions.explanationJa: rather thanによる選択はprefer A to Bで同じ選好を表せます。

questions.prompt: The standard plan includes weekly reports. The premium plan provides updates more frequently ------- the standard plan.

choices.B: as

questions.translationJa: 標準プランには週次報告が含まれます。上位プランは標準プランより頻繁に更新を提供します。
questions.explanationJa: 比較級more frequentlyの基準をthanで導きます。

questions.prompt: Purchasing the equipment would exceed this year’s budget. We will lease it ------- buy it.

choices.B: than

questions.translationJa: 機器を購入すると今年の予算を超えます。購入するのではなく借りることにします。
questions.explanationJa: leaseとbuyを対比するrather thanが文脈に合います。

questions.prompt: The two printers cost the same. However, the laser model is superior ------- the inkjet model in speed.

choices.B: as

questions.translationJa: 2台のプリンターは同価格です。しかし速度ではレーザー機がインクジェット機より優れています。
questions.explanationJa: superiorはtoと組む比較形容詞です。

questions.prompt: The technician restarted the server, but the response time is not ------- than before.

choices.B: faster

questions.translationJa: 技術者はサーバーを再起動しましたが、応答時間は以前より速くなっていません。
questions.explanationJa: not faster than beforeが改善していない状況を表します。

questions.prompt: Mr. Ruiz joined the firm in 2014, and I joined in 2019. Mr. Ruiz is senior ------- me.

choices.B: from

questions.translationJa: ルイスさんは2014年に入社し、私は2019年に入社しました。ルイスさんは私より先輩です。
questions.explanationJa: 職務上の先輩を表すseniorもto＋目的格を取ります。

questions.prompt: The first draft was unclear, so the writer reorganized it. Does the argument seem ------- stronger now?

choices.B: no

questions.translationJa: 初稿は不明瞭だったため、筆者は構成を変えました。論旨は今、少しでも強く感じられますか。
questions.explanationJa: 疑問文で改善の有無を尋ねるany strongerが適切です。

questions.prompt: The substitute part failed after one day. It was no more durable ------- the original damaged part.

choices.B: than

questions.translationJa: 代替部品は1日で故障しました。それは元の破損部品と同様に耐久性がありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: no more durable thanは両方とも耐久性がないという強い評価です。

questions.prompt: The survey contains twenty questions, which is too many for a quick poll. We should shorten it ------- ask participants to spend more time.

choices.B: other than

questions.translationJa: アンケートは20問あり、簡易調査には多すぎます。参加者に時間をかけてもらうのではなく、短くすべきです。
questions.explanationJa: shortenとaskをrather thanで並列し、好ましい方を選びます。

questions.prompt: Last month, the help desk answered 90 percent of calls within a minute. This month’s rate is even higher ------- that.

choices.B: to

questions.translationJa: 先月、ヘルプデスクは90パーセントの電話に1分以内で応答しました。今月の割合はそれよりさらに高いです。
questions.explanationJa: even higherの具体的基準thatはthanで導きます。

questions.prompt: The presentation included more data ------- the audience could absorb in thirty minutes. Several attendees requested a summary.

choices.B: than

questions.translationJa: 発表には聴衆が30分で理解できる以上のデータが含まれていました。複数の参加者が要約を求めました。
questions.explanationJa: more ... than the audience could absorbで処理可能量を超えたことを表します。
